⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **p2, not the suggested p3:** the maintainer ruled "platform first" on hotcrm#2285 (A, 03:24Z), so objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2285 is `Blocked-by` this card and the app guard waits on it. That is a ruled app feature held by a platform gap. It is not a release item, so it is not p1.
- Not a spec-key addition: the sandbox context, the lowerer and the contract note are all on the server side. A read-only `ctx.provenance` (at least `flowRunId`) mirrors the existing referential markers. Keep it read-only in the sandbox, so a body cannot forge the mark.

The level stays `patch` under `Metadata-protocol: none` (ruling A on #25105). `@objectstack/cli` keeps `Clause-②: no` unless its built declarations moved.
